query:
SELECT (EXISTS(
              SELECT 1 FROM project_members WHERE project_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
           ) OR EXISTS(
              SELECT 1 FROM project_groups pg
              JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = pg.group_id
              WHERE pg.project_id = $1 AND gm.user_id = $2
           )) as "exists!"
